meals.recipe_name: Loaded Scrambled Egg & Cheddar Breakfast Burrito
recipe_steps: Crack 4 eggs into a bowl, add 1/4 tsp salt, and whisk vigorously for 30 seconds until uniform.
Melt 1 tbsp butter in a nonstick skillet over medium-low heat (about 300F) until foaming subsides.
Pour in eggs. Let sit 20 seconds, then using a silicone spatula gently push from edges to center, folding soft curds, for about 3 minutes until just set but glossy. Remove from heat.
Warm 1/2 cup black beans in a small pot over medium heat for 2 minutes; drain excess liquid.
Lay the warm 10-inch tortilla flat. Layer eggs down the center, top with 1/2 cup cheddar (residual heat melts it), 1/2 cup beans, sliced 1/2 avocado, and 1/4 cup salsa.
Fold both short sides inward, then roll tightly from the bottom into a burrito.
Return the burrito seam-side down to the skillet over medium heat for 1 minute per side to crisp and seal. Slice in half and serve.

prep_tasks.instructions: Mix 2 cups all-purpose flour, 3/4 tsp salt, 3 tbsp lard/oil, and 2/3 cup warm water. Knead 5 min into a smooth dough, cover, rest at room temp 1 hour, then refrigerate. Divide into portions; roll one 10-inch tortilla and cook on a dry skillet 45 sec/side the morning of.

recipe_steps: Whisk 3 tbsp soy sauce, 2 tbsp mirin, 1 tbsp brown sugar, minced garlic, and 1 tsp grated ginger into a sauce.
Pat chicken thighs dry and cut into 1-inch pieces.
Heat 1 tbsp sesame oil in a skillet over medium-high (about 375F). Add chicken and sear 5 minutes until browned, stirring occasionally.
Add 1 cup broccoli florets and 2 tbsp water; cover and steam 3 minutes.
Pour in the sauce and simmer uncovered 3-4 minutes until it thickens and glazes the chicken.
Serve over 1.5 cups warm rice, spoon extra glaze on top, and sprinkle with sesame seeds.

prep_tasks.instructions: Move 8 oz chicken thighs from freezer to fridge Sunday evening for Monday lunch (~24 hr thaw).
Rinse 2 cups white rice, cook with 3 cups water; refrigerate. Reheat 1.5 cups portions with a splash of water as needed through Tuesday.

meals.recipe_name: Seared Salmon with Garlic Butter Quinoa
recipe_steps: Rinse 3/4 cup quinoa, add to a pot with 1.5 cups water, bring to a boil, cover, reduce to low and simmer 15 minutes; fluff.
Pat salmon dry, season both sides with salt and pepper.
Heat 1 tbsp olive oil in a skillet over medium-high (400F). Place salmon skin-side down and sear 4 minutes without moving.
Flip salmon, add 2 tbsp butter and minced garlic to the pan, and baste salmon with foaming butter for 3 minutes.
Add trimmed asparagus to the pan for the last 3 minutes, turning to coat in butter.
Squeeze 1/2 lemon over everything. Serve salmon and asparagus over the garlic-butter quinoa.

prep_tasks.instructions: Move 8 oz salmon from freezer to fridge Sunday night for Monday dinner (~24 hr). If forgotten, cold-water thaw in sealed bag Monday afternoon ~30 min, changing water every 30 min.

recipe_steps: Spoon 1.5 cups Greek yogurt into a bowl.
Top with 3/4 cup mixed berries, 1/3 cup granola, and 1 tbsp chia seeds.
Drizzle 1 tbsp honey over the top and serve immediately.
Add 1.5 cups milk, 1 banana, 1 scoop protein powder, 2 tbsp peanut butter, and 1/4 cup oats to a blender.
Blend on high 45 seconds until smooth. Serve immediately.
Blend 1 cup cottage cheese, 3 eggs, 3/4 cup oats, 1 banana, 1 tsp baking powder, and 1 tsp vanilla until smooth. Let batter rest 5 minutes.
Melt 1 tbsp butter in a nonstick skillet over medium heat (325F).
Pour 1/4-cup portions of batter, cook 2-3 minutes until bubbles form on top, flip, and cook 1-2 minutes more.
Repeat with remaining batter (about 6 pancakes). Stack and drizzle with 2 tbsp maple syrup.
Soak 4 oz rice noodles in warm water 20 minutes until pliable; drain.
Whisk 2 tbsp fish sauce, 1 tbsp tamarind paste, 1.5 tbsp brown sugar, and juice of 1/2 lime into a sauce.
Heat 2 tbsp oil in a wok over high heat. Add shrimp and stir-fry 2 minutes until pink; push to one side.
Crack 2 eggs into the empty side, scramble 30 seconds, then combine with shrimp.
Add drained noodles and the sauce; toss constantly 2-3 minutes until noodles absorb the sauce.
Add 1 cup bean sprouts and sliced green onion; toss 1 minute.
Plate and top with 3 tbsp crushed peanuts and remaining lime wedges.

prep_tasks.instructions: Move 8 oz shrimp from freezer to fridge Monday night for Tuesday lunch. Or cold-water thaw sealed ~15 min Tuesday morning.

recipe_steps: Heat 1 tbsp sesame oil in a skillet over medium-high. Add ground beef and minced garlic; brown 6 minutes. Add 2 tbsp soy sauce and cook 1 minute; set aside.
In the same pan, saute julienned carrot 2 minutes; remove. Add spinach and wilt 1 minute; remove.
Fry 1 egg sunny-side up in remaining oil, 2-3 minutes.
Arrange 1.5 cups warm rice in a bowl, top with beef, carrot, and spinach in sections.
Add the fried egg, 2 tbsp gochujang, drizzle 1 tbsp sesame oil, and sprinkle sesame seeds. Mix before eating.

prep_tasks.instructions: Move 8 oz ground beef from freezer to fridge Monday night for Tuesday dinner (~24 hr).

recipe_steps: Drain tuna and mix with 2 tbsp Greek yogurt, 1 tsp lemon juice, and 1/4 tsp salt.
Mash 1/2 avocado and spread across 3 rice cakes.
Top each with the tuna mixture and serve.
Combine 1.5 cups milk, 1 scoop chocolate protein, 1/3 cup oats, 1 tbsp peanut butter, and 1 banana in a blender.
Blend 45 seconds until smooth and serve.
Slice and toast the homemade bagel; spread each half with 1 tbsp cream cheese.
Whisk 3 eggs. Melt 1 tbsp butter in a nonstick skillet over medium-low; softly scramble eggs 3 minutes until just set.
Layer scrambled eggs on bagel halves, top with 3 oz smoked salmon, 1 tbsp capers, and 2 tbsp thinly sliced red onion. Serve open-faced.

prep_tasks.instructions: Mix 3 cups bread flour, 1 tsp yeast, 1.5 tsp salt, 1 tbsp sugar, 1 cup warm water. Knead 10 min, proof 1 hr, shape 4 bagels, boil 30 sec/side in water with 1 tbsp honey, bake 425F 20 min. Cool and freeze extras.
Move 1 bagel from freezer to fridge Tuesday night; toast Wednesday morning.

meals.recipe_name: Turkey Pesto Ciabatta with Sweet Potato Wedges
recipe_steps: Preheat oven to 425F. Cut sweet potato into wedges, toss with 1 tbsp olive oil and 1/4 tsp salt, roast 25 minutes flipping halfway.
Season 7 oz ground turkey with 1/4 tsp salt, form into a flat patty. Heat 1 tbsp oil in a skillet over medium-high and cook patty 4 minutes per side to 165F.
Slice ciabatta, spread 2 tbsp pesto, layer turkey patty, 1/3 cup mozzarella, and sliced tomato.
Return sandwich to skillet 1 minute per side to melt cheese and toast bread. Serve with wedges.

prep_tasks.instructions: Move 7 oz ground turkey from freezer to fridge Tuesday night for Wednesday lunch.
Mix 3 cups bread flour, 1.25 cups water, 1 tsp yeast, 1.5 tsp salt into a wet dough. Bulk ferment 2 hr with folds, shape 4 rolls, bake 450F 22 min. Cool, freeze; thaw Tuesday night.

meals.recipe_name: Pork Tenderloin with Apple Cider Glaze & Mashed Potatoes
recipe_steps: Peel and cube potatoes; boil in salted water 15 minutes until tender. Drain, mash with 2 tbsp butter, 1/4 cup milk, and 1/2 tsp salt.
Season pork with 1/4 tsp salt. Heat 1 tbsp olive oil in an oven-safe skillet over high; sear pork 2 minutes per side all around.
Transfer skillet to 400F oven and roast 12 minutes to 145F internal. Rest 5 minutes.
In the skillet, simmer 1/2 cup apple cider and 1 tbsp Dijon 4 minutes until syrupy; whisk in 1 tbsp butter.
Steam green beans 4 minutes. Slice pork, drizzle glaze, and serve with mash and beans.

prep_tasks.instructions: Move 8 oz pork tenderloin from freezer to fridge Tuesday night for Wednesday dinner (~24 hr).

recipe_steps: Spoon 1 cup cottage cheese into a bowl.
Top with 3/4 cup pineapple, 2 tbsp chopped walnuts, and drizzle 1 tbsp honey. Serve.
Blend 1.5 cups milk, 1 scoop vanilla protein, 2 tbsp almond butter, 1/3 cup oats, and 1 tbsp honey 45 seconds. Serve.
Heat 1 tbsp olive oil in a skillet over medium. Saute diced onion and bell pepper 5 minutes.
Add 1 tsp cumin and 1 tsp paprika; cook 30 seconds. Add 1 cup crushed tomatoes and simmer 5 minutes.
Make 4 wells in the sauce and crack in eggs. Cover and cook 6-8 minutes until whites set.
Crumble 1/4 cup feta over top. Serve with 2 slices toasted homemade bread.

prep_tasks.instructions: Mix 3.5 cups bread flour, 1.25 cups water, 2 tsp salt, 1 tsp yeast. Knead 10 min, proof 90 min, shape loaf, proof 45 min, bake 450F 35 min. Cool, slice, freeze; toast slices from frozen Thursday.

recipe_steps: Toss chicken with 1 tbsp olive oil, 1 tsp cumin, 1 tsp paprika, 1/2 tsp turmeric, and lemon juice.
Heat 1 tbsp oil in a skillet over medium-high; cook chicken 6-7 minutes until charred and 165F. Slice.
Mix 1/4 cup Greek yogurt with grated garlic clove for sauce.
Build bowl: 1.25 cups rice, sliced chicken, diced cucumber and tomato, drizzle garlic yogurt sauce.

prep_tasks.instructions: Move 8 oz chicken thighs from freezer to fridge Wednesday night; combine with spices/oil/lemon in a bag and marinate overnight (12-16 hr) for Thursday lunch.
Cook 2 cups rice with 3 cups water Wednesday; refrigerate for Thursday-Friday use.

recipe_steps: Preheat oven to 400F. For cornbread, mix 3/4 cup cornmeal, 1/2 cup flour, 1 tsp baking powder, 1 egg, 1/2 cup milk, 2 tbsp melted butter. Pour into greased pan, bake 18 minutes.
Brown 8 oz bison with diced onion in a pot over medium-high 6 minutes.
Add 1.5 tbsp chili powder, 1 cup crushed tomatoes, and 1 cup kidney beans. Simmer 12 minutes, stirring.
Serve chili hot with a wedge of fresh cornbread.

prep_tasks.instructions: Move 8 oz ground bison from freezer to fridge Wednesday night for Thursday dinner (~24 hr).

recipe_steps: Add 1.5 cups Greek yogurt to a bowl.
Top with sliced banana, 2 tbsp almonds, and 1 tbsp honey. Serve.
Blend 1.5 cups milk, 1 scoop protein, 1 cup berries, 1/3 cup oats, and 1 tbsp peanut butter 45 seconds. Serve.

meals.recipe_name: Steak and Eggs with Hash Browns
recipe_steps: Grate potato, squeeze out moisture. Heat 1 tbsp oil in a skillet over medium-high, press potato into a patty and cook 4 minutes per side until crisp; season with salt.
Season steak with salt and pepper. In a hot skillet with 1 tbsp butter, sear 3 minutes per side for medium; rest 5 minutes and slice.
Fry 3 eggs in 1 tbsp butter to preference. Plate steak, eggs, and hash browns.

prep_tasks.instructions: Move 6 oz sirloin from freezer to fridge Thursday night for Friday breakfast (~24 hr).

meals.recipe_name: Spaghetti Aglio e Olio with Shrimp
recipe_steps: Boil spaghetti in salted water per package (~9 min). Reserve 1/2 cup pasta water; drain.
Heat 3 tbsp olive oil over medium, add thinly sliced garlic and 1/2 tsp red pepper flakes; cook 2 minutes until fragrant, not browned.
Add shrimp and cook 3 minutes until pink.
Add pasta, a splash of pasta water, and toss 1 minute to emulsify. Off heat, add parsley, lemon juice, and 1/4 cup parmesan. Serve.

prep_tasks.instructions: Move 7 oz shrimp from freezer to fridge Thursday night for Friday lunch. Or cold-water thaw ~15 min Friday morning.

recipe_steps: Preheat broiler. Mix 2 tbsp miso, 1 tbsp mirin, 1 tbsp soy sauce, 1 tbsp honey. Brush over salmon.
Broil salmon 8-10 minutes on a lined tray until glaze caramelizes and fish flakes.
Boil soba per package (~5 min), drain, toss with 1 tbsp sesame oil.
Saute bok choy 3 minutes in a hot pan. Plate soba, salmon, bok choy; garnish with sliced green onion.

prep_tasks.instructions: Move 8 oz salmon from freezer to fridge Thursday night for Friday dinner (~24 hr).

recipe_steps: Toast 2 slices homemade bread.
Spread 1 cup cottage cheese over toast, top with sliced tomato, drizzle 1 tbsp olive oil, and season with pepper. Serve.
Blend 1.5 cups milk, 1/2 cup cold brew, 1 scoop chocolate protein, 1 banana, and 1 tbsp peanut butter 45 seconds. Serve.

meals.recipe_name: Ham, Egg and Cheese Breakfast Sandwich
recipe_steps: Split and toast the homemade english muffin.
In a buttered skillet over medium, fry 3 eggs; sear 3 oz ham 1 minute per side.
Layer eggs, ham, and 1/3 cup cheddar on muffin (residual heat melts cheese); add sliced 1/2 avocado. Serve.

prep_tasks.instructions: Mix 2 cups flour, 1 tsp yeast, 1 tsp salt, 1 tbsp sugar, 3/4 cup warm milk, 1 tbsp butter. Knead 8 min, proof 1 hr, cut rounds, dust with cornmeal, cook on griddle 6 min/side. Cool, freeze; toast from frozen Saturday.

meals.recipe_name: Korean Beef Lettuce Wraps with Rice
recipe_steps: Heat 1 tbsp sesame oil over medium-high; brown 8 oz beef with minced garlic and 1 tsp ginger 6 minutes.
Add 2 tbsp soy sauce, 1 tbsp brown sugar, and 1 tbsp gochujang; simmer 2 minutes until glazed.
Serve beef with 1.25 cups rice and butter lettuce leaves for wrapping; garnish with green onion.

prep_tasks.instructions: Move 8 oz ground beef from freezer to fridge Friday night for Saturday lunch (~24 hr).
Cook 2 cups rice with 3 cups water Friday; refrigerate for Saturday-Sunday use.

meals.recipe_name: Herb-Roasted Chicken Thighs with Couscous and Zucchini
recipe_steps: Preheat oven to 425F. Rub chicken with 1 tbsp olive oil, minced garlic, 1 tsp rosemary, 1/2 tsp salt.
Sear chicken skin-side down in an oven-safe skillet 4 minutes, flip, then roast 20 minutes to 175F.
Boil 3/4 cup water, stir in 3/4 cup couscous off heat, cover 5 minutes, fluff.
Saute sliced zucchini in 1 tbsp oil 4 minutes with a pinch of salt. Squeeze lemon over chicken and serve with couscous and zucchini.

prep_tasks.instructions: Move 10 oz bone-in chicken thighs from freezer to fridge Friday night for Saturday dinner (~24 hr).

recipe_steps: Layer 1.5 cups Greek yogurt, 3/4 cup berries, and 1/3 cup granola in a glass.
Drizzle 1 tbsp honey and serve.
Blend 1.5 cups milk, 1 scoop protein, 1 cup strawberries, 1 banana, and 2 tbsp almond butter 45 seconds. Serve.

meals.recipe_name: Savory Oatmeal with Fried Egg and Turkey Bacon
recipe_steps: Cook 3/4 cup oats with 1.5 cups water and 1/4 tsp salt over medium 5 minutes; stir in 1/4 cup cheddar and 1 cup spinach until wilted.
In a skillet, cook 3 turkey bacon strips 3 minutes per side until crisp.
Fry 2 eggs in 1 tbsp butter. Top oatmeal with bacon and eggs. Serve.
Cook 7 oz turkey with 1 tbsp oil, 1 tsp cumin, and 1 tsp chili powder over medium-high 6 minutes; stir in 1/2 cup black beans.
Lay a tortilla in a dry skillet over medium, sprinkle half the cheddar, add turkey-bean mix, remaining cheddar, and top with second tortilla.
Cook 2-3 minutes per side until golden and cheese melts. Slice into wedges and serve with salsa.

prep_tasks.instructions: Move 7 oz ground turkey from freezer to fridge Saturday night for Sunday lunch (~24 hr).
Use reserved tortilla dough from Sunday's earlier batch; roll two 10-inch rounds and cook on dry skillet 45 sec/side Sunday, or use frozen extras.

recipe_steps: Bring 1 cup milk and 1.5 cups water to a boil, whisk in 3/4 cup grits, reduce to low, cook 18 minutes stirring often; stir in 1/2 cup cheddar and 1 tbsp butter.
Melt 2 tbsp butter in a skillet over medium-high, add minced garlic and 1/2 tsp paprika 30 seconds.
Add shrimp and cook 3 minutes until pink; finish with lemon juice and parsley.
Spoon grits into a bowl, top with garlic butter shrimp and pan sauce. Serve.

prep_tasks.instructions: Move 8 oz shrimp from freezer to fridge Saturday night for Sunday dinner. Or cold-water thaw ~15 min Sunday afternoon.

recipe_steps: Spoon 1 cup cottage cheese into a bowl.
Top with sliced peach, 2 tbsp walnuts, and 1 tbsp honey. Serve.
Blend 1.5 cups milk, 1 scoop chocolate protein, 2 tbsp peanut butter, 1 banana, and 1/3 cup oats 45 seconds. Serve.
